verdict.rationale: Generating SSH keys is a fair question for an iOS Unix-like terminal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions ssh-keygen, SSH key pair generation, or password-less server access. The listed ios_system commands (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex) and pkg packages (zip, unzip, xz, ffmpeg) include no SSH tooling.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can generate SSH key pairs for password-less access to my servers
